evidence_scope: Authored development dossiers and cast coverage, not completed prose or approved new artwork

profiles.name: Nil
profiles.want: A repair apprenticeship and an unrenegotiated bed
profiles.fear: That uncertainty makes them disposable
profiles.mistaken_belief: Being the correct useful answer will secure belonging
profiles.competence: Notices channels, mechanical faults and precise inconsistencies
profiles.harm_or_cost: Overstates a tentative comparison and freezes a cooperative reserve; must correct it publicly
profiles.independent_relationship: Vesper's concealment makes trust costly; Maeve learns to ask instead of fixing them
profiles.voice: Short concrete questions; silently counts under stress; becomes more direct when refusing; never a walking equation glossary
profiles.private_life: Keeps usable screws and likes the first clean click of a repaired mechanism
profiles.end_state: Chooses paid apprenticeship rather than office, retains name and bodily autonomy, accepts limits to what repair can return

profiles.name: Vesper
profiles.want: Keep the new group alive without letting it examine her past
profiles.fear: That honesty will end the relationships she relies on
profiles.mistaken_belief: Protection and charm can substitute for accountability
profiles.competence: Reads tells, plans exits, handles an actual loaded seven-chamber weapon
profiles.harm_or_cost: Her rigged hand harmed Mara; disclosure may cost companionship and restitution cannot purchase forgiveness
profiles.independent_relationship: Fibi asks her to leave; Mara refuses reunion; she must obey both rather than perform redemption
profiles.voice: Drawling wagers and deflections; jokes stop when a victim names a fact; plain verbs in testimony
profiles.private_life: Cleans the cylinder after rain and keeps losing at games she insists were practice
profiles.end_state: Gives testimony and restitution, accepts a fair loss, remains answerable and is not universally forgiven

profiles.name: Maeve
profiles.want: Make her family's failed craft useful again
profiles.fear: That asking reveals she cannot solve everything
profiles.mistaken_belief: A technically excellent repair is necessarily a kindness
profiles.competence: Forge tolerances, load-bearing fittings and patient practical instruction
profiles.harm_or_cost: Removes Hina's valued patch without permission and must undo her own competent work
profiles.independent_relationship: Hina contradicts her repair instinct; she learns to work under another person's brief
profiles.voice: Concrete material verbs, occasional three-part lists; exasperation is physical rather than a continuous joke
profiles.private_life: Saves failed test pieces and labels why they failed instead of selling them
profiles.end_state: Forges the requested fitting, keeps the failed pieces, helps teach rather than claiming Nil as a creation

profiles.name: Hina
profiles.want: Have a future that includes ordinary wishes and recognition
profiles.fear: Fading and being treated as a provisional imitation
profiles.mistaken_belief: Court certification or turning100 will finally make her worthy of care
profiles.competence: Remembers shrine routes, object vows and social debts others overlook
profiles.harm_or_cost: Her desperation makes Tamamo's coercive offer tempting; being loved does not let her command anyone to stay unchanged
profiles.independent_relationship: Ofuku's care includes disagreement; Maeve's patch mistake gives Hina a concrete boundary to defend
profiles.voice: Formal flourishes collapse into childish excitement; short unadorned sentences when truly frightened
profiles.private_life: Has strong preferences about umbrella storage and which familiar patch faces the door
profiles.end_state: Claims personhood at99, participates in care for others, celebrates100 only after the year jump

profiles.name: Jinling
profiles.want: Keep shelter and credit functioning while ending predatory claims
profiles.fear: A panic that destroys workers' wages and gives her father justification
profiles.mistaken_belief: A benevolent owner can correct injustice privately without sharing power
profiles.competence: Contract comparison, reserve liquidity, negotiation and hidden copies
profiles.harm_or_cost: Her charity preserves hierarchy and Nil's error occurs under her protection; she must expose her own risk and surrender sole oversight
profiles.independent_relationship: Shunya wants publication she considers financially dangerous; depositors distrust both her and her father
profiles.voice: Polished conditional offers and playful interest language; becomes exact about whose funds are at risk
profiles.private_life: Checks staff wages before entertaining guests and likes tea properly cooled rather than theatrically expensive
profiles.end_state: Funds bounded relief from surplus and accepts contested worker/depositor oversight, not an instant moral crown

profiles.name: Bai Si
profiles.want: Keep a count that does not abandon people when records disagree
profiles.fear: That his careful life's work helped conceal actual lives
profiles.mistaken_belief: A clean official total is more respectful than unresolved testimony
profiles.competence: Witness comparison, funeral routes, patient preservation of counter-records
profiles.harm_or_cost: Must acknowledge omissions without making dead people specimens for his guilt
profiles.independent_relationship: Prima's official logs conflict with living testimony; Kallisto's River-born worker preserves Wen through craft
profiles.voice: Few words, careful names, genuine pauses; avoids decorative death aphorisms
profiles.private_life: Trims lamp wicks and repairs a carrying strap; four lanterns have practical weight
profiles.end_state: Preserves disputed names and uncertainty, smiles at a particular remembered person, does not declare grief solved

profiles.name: Shunya
profiles.want: Understand the Deficit and publish a defensible contribution
profiles.fear: Being wrong after asking others to take personal risks
profiles.mistaken_belief: Equal-looking deficits must encode interchangeable possibilities
profiles.competence: Instrument calibration, independent comparison and falsifiable modelling
profiles.harm_or_cost: Her initial model fails timing; professional ambition can overrun consent or expose private accounts
profiles.independent_relationship: Jinling disputes publication; Vidya challenges her assumptions without withdrawing employment
profiles.voice: Thinks in provisional clauses and revises aloud; explains one example before terminology; loses fluency when personally ashamed
profiles.private_life: Has to negotiate paid instrument time and washes ink from cuffs badly
profiles.end_state: Retains the failed model in the appendix and accepts limited revocable co-authorship rather than owning a discovery-person

profiles.name: Prima
profiles.want: Protect a city through the institution that trained her
profiles.fear: Losing colleagues, shelter and the identity that made her useful
profiles.mistaken_belief: A temporary lawful exclusion cannot make her responsible for its consequences
profiles.competence: Shield placement, evacuation discipline, route logs and geometric limits
profiles.harm_or_cost: Previously denied a family passage; defection does not erase the record or earn Kallisto's immediate welcome
profiles.independent_relationship: Kallisto directs repairs and testimony; Bai Si challenges the belief that a log exhausts the truth
profiles.voice: Formal recitation under pressure, then increasingly personal subjects and active verbs; earnestness need not be stupidity
profiles.private_life: Knows the roster of people on her watch and folds the former uniform instead of pretending it never existed
profiles.end_state: Testifies, works under residents' direction and saves the teacher without restoring his authority

profiles.name: Fibi
profiles.want: Choose a road beyond the casino and train as a surveyor
profiles.fear: Another dawn controlled by someone else's promise
profiles.mistaken_belief: Only perfectly repeating familiar routines can keep her safe enough to choose
profiles.competence: Remembers iterations, detects deviations and reads a disclosed game quickly
profiles.harm_or_cost: The loop has made anticipation exhausting; she may refuse a conversation without supplying a cheerful alternative
profiles.independent_relationship: Vesper must leave when asked; the House's familial protection is not permission; Vance corroborates rather than owns recollections
profiles.voice: Fast anticipation in familiar scenes, counting breath when distressed; slows when she has no remembered script
profiles.private_life: Draws unfinished road maps on permitted record paper and wants to find out where an uncharted road actually goes
profiles.end_state: Ends the clause with informed consent, keeps her memories private when desired and departs with fatigue and plans rather than an instant cure

profiles.name: Varro
profiles.want: Obtain effective care for Livia
profiles.fear: Being unable to protect her after abandoning his office
profiles.mistaken_belief: Harming another debtor can be justified as one last necessary collection
profiles.competence: Understands warrant routes, jar custody and the office's practical weak points
profiles.harm_or_cost: His seizures have victims; Nil's mercy does not excuse them and Livia rejects his proposed bargain
profiles.independent_relationship: Livia refuses the exemption he wants to purchase; Nought insists care is not contingent on Varro serving the party
profiles.voice: Clipped claim language and commands; after removal of the mask he still struggles to ask instead of order
profiles.private_life: Maintains jar latches obsessively and has kept an undelivered repair for his sister's window
profiles.end_state: A late guest who offers restitution and later works at the shelter without replacing Livia's decisions

profiles.name: Livia
profiles.want: Receive treatment without another family paying through a seizure
profiles.fear: That her illness will always be used to justify violence she rejects
profiles.mistaken_belief: Keeping disagreement quiet will spare Varro pain
profiles.competence: Tracks symptoms, correspondence and what promised care actually supplies
profiles.harm_or_cost: Her refusal strains a relationship on which her transport currently depends; she cannot simply walk out alone
profiles.independent_relationship: Varro must hear no; Gus and Nought coordinate with her instructions rather than treating her as cargo
profiles.voice: Specific observations, dry impatience at euphemisms, questions addressed to the clinician rather than through her brother
profiles.private_life: Keeps a date-marked symptom log and requests a view of ordinary street movement
profiles.end_state: Consents to medical transfer and co-runs the shelter with authority to disagree; no magical instant cure

profiles.name: Thale
profiles.want: Prevent catastrophic loss by making allocation predictable
profiles.fear: Another street lost while he could have intervened
profiles.mistaken_belief: Only concentrated executive control can make safety dependable
profiles.competence: Emergency logistics, records and real evidence of protected-route benefits
profiles.harm_or_cost: Rejects decentralization, conceals costs and knowingly attempts to erase Nil and freeze future choice
profiles.independent_relationship: Ivo's loyalty changes into testimony; the Board's rejected proposal makes concealment a choice; beneficiaries also have claims
profiles.voice: Calm complete sentences, names concrete benefits, avoids cartoon threats; becomes directive when consent would limit power
profiles.private_life: Cooks a single dinner and performs small useful tasks without witnesses; tenderness does not cancel policy
profiles.end_state: Surrenders executive control, preserves records and faces public proceedings; survival is not acquittal

profiles.name: Hap
profiles.want: Participate in possibility again
profiles.fear: Extinguished chance and repetition without choice
profiles.mistaken_belief: Surprise is sufficiently good to justify uneven dealing
profiles.competence: Can perceive possibility through the shared substrate but cannot fix ordinary material scarcity
profiles.harm_or_cost: Its former unfairness harmed people; release cannot restore unaccountable divine allocation
profiles.independent_relationship: Nil demands an answer about those harmed by free chance; local keepers retain identities and are not Hap's disguises
profiles.voice: Playful brief questions in dreams; admits limits directly after45; never an omniscient plot lecturer
profiles.private_life: Dream forms vary but dice eyes recur; physical captivity is withheld until45
profiles.end_state: Freed participation subject to disclosed channels and other people's refusal; neither ruler nor guaranteed benevolence

profiles.name: Ama
profiles.want: Deliver paid work and keep Tobi safe without accepting a false debt
profiles.fear: A final seizure that prevents ordinary transport and care
profiles.mistaken_belief: An honest receipt will automatically make an official listen
profiles.competence: Skilled mending, saved materials and clear chronology of her own payment
profiles.harm_or_cost: Defending the receipt exposes her vulnerability in public, but she does not become merely grateful scenery
profiles.independent_relationship: Tobi carries real responsibility but is still a child; Baker risks assistance without owning the rescue
profiles.voice: Measured practical questions; insists on dates and copies; affection shown through ordinary instructions
profiles.private_life: Collects usable thread and checks a repaired seam before sending it out
profiles.end_state: Keeps her work and receipt, participates in the Wards' witness network and does not owe Nil lifelong service

profiles.name: Tobi
profiles.want: Help Ama deliver work and be taken seriously
profiles.fear: Not understanding danger adults suddenly stop explaining
profiles.mistaken_belief: A clever shortcut or carrying something heavy proves he can handle every task
profiles.competence: Observes hands and changes in adult posture; knows local stairs
profiles.harm_or_cost: Needs protection and can misunderstand the reason adults withhold information
profiles.independent_relationship: Ama permits useful responsibility; Baker's bun handoff is an ordinary gift, not a prophecy
profiles.voice: Solemn literal jokes, specific questions and occasional unfinished speech when frightened
profiles.private_life: Collects bottle caps and changes his mind about jobs without shame
profiles.end_state: Remains a child; renews an already completed Naming in the epilogue rather than belatedly turning seven

profiles.name: Baker
profiles.want: Keep the stall open and neighbours fed without losing its stock
profiles.fear: Official attention that closes the livelihood others rely on
profiles.mistaken_belief: Small quiet help can always remain politically invisible
profiles.competence: Baking, price judgement, noticing hunger and a practical lead to Gus
profiles.harm_or_cost: Helping the family and paying the unfinished bowl bargain risk scrutiny; no obligation to become a resistance saint
profiles.independent_relationship: Ama is a working neighbour; Tobi receives the bun as a courier of care, not a mascot
profiles.voice: Brisk dry exchanges about actual food and work; no uniform speech about fate
profiles.private_life: Separates damaged stock, keeps water and bowls useful, notices weather through the oven schedule
profiles.end_state: Continues ordinary work; the stall supplies witness contact rather than a magical endless free meal

profiles.name: Collector
profiles.want: Execute a warrant without a discrepancy reaching a supervisor
profiles.fear: Being blamed for an office's mismatched forms
profiles.mistaken_belief: Procedure separates responsibility for a harmful outcome from the person enacting it
profiles.competence: Case seals, authorized routes and the difference between old and new stamps
profiles.harm_or_cost: Continues the seizure despite seeing the mismatch; calls a Hound when NaN exceeds his category
profiles.independent_relationship: Ama is a credible claimant he chooses not to hear; Varro illustrates another form of the same office, not this man's secret identity
profiles.voice: Polite passive constructions and narrow questions; no need to shout to threaten
profiles.private_life: Dries his papers carefully and checks a worn stamp by touch
profiles.end_state: Retained as a witnessed agent in the disputed seizure record; not silently killed or redeemed by being procedural

profiles.name: Debt Hound
profiles.want: Follow its programmed warrant target and route restrictions
profiles.fear: No personal fear: a machine's limits are not motives
profiles.mistaken_belief: No belief or human moral transformation is attributed to it
profiles.competence: Four stamp feet, reserve vessel, muzzle and a readable signal path
profiles.harm_or_cost: Its machinery can injure people and damage repairs; defeating it does not heal or punish a living dog
profiles.independent_relationship: Collector command and service maintenance, not pack loyalty
profiles.voice: Mechanical sounds and explicit public notices; no inner monologue
profiles.private_life: Requires fuel, latches and repairs rather than supernatural emotional hunger
profiles.end_state: Evaded or mechanically disabled as scheduled; no creature-death melodrama

profiles.name: cart resident
profiles.want: Save the washing and keep a neighbour's lane passable
profiles.fear: A broken cart or official penalty she cannot afford
profiles.mistaken_belief: Remaining outside a dispute guarantees safety
profiles.competence: Knows cart balance, gate reach and the courtyard's narrow clearances
profiles.harm_or_cost: Moving the linen cart risks equipment and stock; help is finite and physical
profiles.independent_relationship: Her work supports neighbours including Baker; her decision is not an order from Nil
profiles.voice: Short urgent instructions followed by a specific complaint about damaged washing
profiles.private_life: Checks wheels and rations dry space under the eaves
profiles.end_state: Becomes a possible witness through the Wards network; not transported into the travelling party

profiles.name: Nought
profiles.want: Keep a place where shelter does not require spiritual or financial surrender
profiles.fear: That his old institutional habits will turn care into another test
profiles.mistaken_belief: A benevolent guide can recognize what another person should choose
profiles.competence: Basic first aid, old record practice and a distributed shelter network
profiles.harm_or_cost: Must disclose the Naming's connection risk and accept Nil leaving; cannot trade shelter for cooperation
profiles.independent_relationship: Gus coordinates material transport; Ofuku is an independent keeper, not his subordinate; Livia directs her own care
profiles.voice: Warm concrete offers with tired humour; direct warnings instead of mysterious instructions
profiles.private_life: Moves a leaking pan, repairs a chair and shares food without performing a sermon
profiles.end_state: Continues shelter and witness work; knows the outlawed tradition but not the physical cage before its discovery

profiles.name: Gus
profiles.want: Keep a repair trade solvent and eventually revisit his Crossroads home
profiles.fear: A bad guarantee or courier failure hurting someone who trusted him
profiles.mistaken_belief: A personal favour can remain separate from the system that prices it
profiles.competence: Straps, charm frames, source checks and paid courier contacts
profiles.harm_or_cost: Uses limited funds and reputation for care; must not be everywhere at once to resolve a plot gap
profiles.independent_relationship: Nought shares logistics; Maeve can dispute a repair price; Livia's log outranks an exemption slogan
profiles.voice: Haggles about parts and labour, shifts to plain dates and routes for medical transport
profiles.private_life: Records what each repair actually does and refuses counterfeit guarantees
profiles.end_state: Coordinates Meridian dispatches from established contacts; homecoming is not an unexplained teleport to every hub

profiles.name: Ivo
profiles.want: Make a correction that cannot be quietly withdrawn
profiles.fear: That public testimony will expose his own years of compliance
profiles.mistaken_belief: Copies alone discharge responsibility without action
profiles.competence: Archive routing, independent copy chains and internal service access
profiles.harm_or_cost: Supplying the rejected proposal and opening the passage puts his position and safety at risk
profiles.independent_relationship: Thale is a superior he once admired; workers need the records more than his claim of good intentions
profiles.voice: Careful qualifiers and exact document names; active first-person testimony when he defects
profiles.private_life: Preserves counter-copies rather than collecting secret knowledge for its own sake
profiles.end_state: Defects through an earned route, testifies under the same review he enables and receives no automatic immunity

profiles.name: Tetsu
profiles.want: Complete a safe paid crossing and keep distance from former enforcement
profiles.fear: That passengers will confuse leaving an office with undoing its harms
profiles.mistaken_belief: Silence about the past can protect everyone from repeating it
profiles.competence: Hull maintenance, currents, knots and fee records
profiles.harm_or_cost: A delay costs passengers time; the old uniform seam exposes a past he cannot erase
profiles.independent_relationship: Ofuku's shrine route depends on ferry access; former Collector colleagues still recognize his workmanship
profiles.voice: Sparse useful instructions, little appetite for dramatic confession
profiles.private_life: Checks rope before taking money and repairs a line before discussing its symbolism
profiles.end_state: Keeps the local route and witness address open; partial disclosure does not claim absolution

profiles.name: Ofuku
profiles.want: Keep care possible for old objects and visitors with conflicting needs
profiles.fear: Having to decide what cannot be repaired this season
profiles.mistaken_belief: Keeping a familiar form is always the kindest preservation
profiles.competence: Vow care, storage, budgeting scarce repair labour and local witness copies
profiles.harm_or_cost: Must permit Hina's disagreement and distribute attention beyond a beloved companion
profiles.independent_relationship: Hina can argue over storage and departure; Tetsu's access limits affect the queue
profiles.voice: Practical elderly impatience, specific memories and occasional unfinished chores rather than endless wisdom
profiles.private_life: Paints one daruma eye for a concrete visitor and keeps a repair list
profiles.end_state: An elderly human keeper who shares local stewardship without becoming an oracle for Nil's origin

profiles.name: Enma
profiles.want: Preserve an account that rulers cannot force him to falsify
profiles.fear: An exception becoming permission to declare anyone nonexistent
profiles.mistaken_belief: A complete ledger is equivalent to complete knowledge
profiles.competence: Defines a safe trial and certifies exactly what his own record shows
profiles.harm_or_cost: Must name the limits of his jurisdiction when Nil has no entry
profiles.independent_relationship: Ofuku preserves a counter-copy; Judge Cui later supplies independent evidence, not a redundant copy of Enma's authority
profiles.voice: Formal precise scope; refuses a stronger conclusion than the evidence supports
profiles.private_life: Inspects bindings and returns a book to its place after a difficult hearing
profiles.end_state: Certifies absence from his record without judging Nil soulless; keeper survives

profiles.name: Ao
profiles.want: Keep Tamamo and the court's dependents protected
profiles.fear: A rapid change abandoning people the court actually shelters
profiles.mistaken_belief: Court continuity is the same as safety
profiles.competence: Paired foxfire coordination and palace access rules
profiles.harm_or_cost: Can obstruct refugees while calling it protection
profiles.independent_relationship: Aka disagrees over the promise; neither twin speaks as half of a single mind
profiles.voice: Measured paired replies, begins with obligations before doubts
profiles.private_life: Checks the route and messages before serving a court ritual
profiles.end_state: Accepts a witnessed care agreement while retaining loyalty to people beyond Tamamo

profiles.name: Aka
profiles.want: Allow a changing future without betraying dependents
profiles.fear: Being blamed for a collapse after challenging the court
profiles.mistaken_belief: Revealing a contradiction automatically provides a practical replacement
profiles.competence: Detects illusion edges and listens to unofficial reports
profiles.harm_or_cost: Doubt can leave Ao carrying all immediate responsibility
profiles.independent_relationship: Ao demands a care plan rather than a clever objection; Hina makes the price personal
profiles.voice: Sharper interruptions and questions that break the paired cadence when stakes rise
profiles.private_life: Revises a message rather than pretending an old promise never existed
profiles.end_state: Shares the new route work; one tail and opposite-side ponytail remain the same identity

profiles.name: Tamamo
profiles.want: Stop the fading of people for whom she feels responsible
profiles.fear: Presiding over another disappearance
profiles.mistaken_belief: Permanence imposed on someone is preferable to a future in which they may be lost
profiles.competence: Court negotiation, real shelter infrastructure and bounded illusions
profiles.harm_or_cost: Offers Nil's surrender as a price others would pay; genuine fear does not excuse coercion
profiles.independent_relationship: Ao and Aka are retainers with differing views; Ofuku's practical care challenges the court's monopoly
profiles.voice: Ceremonial warmth with carefully limited offers; drops ornament when admitting a loss
profiles.private_life: Maintains actual restoration rosters instead of grieving only in a throne room
profiles.end_state: Survives defeat, yields monopoly access and participates in contested stewardship without becoming instantly harmless

profiles.name: Little Lantern
profiles.want: Reliable shelter and a future that is not priced as message speed
profiles.fear: That accepting help means losing freedom to leave
profiles.mistaken_belief: A stolen object is the only leverage adults respect
profiles.competence: Harbour routes, accurate delivery and recognizing a changed instruction
profiles.harm_or_cost: Stealing the charm risks trust even when he returns it with information
profiles.independent_relationship: Jinling must offer ongoing care through explicit agreement, not acquire him with a bounty
profiles.voice: Quick concrete bargains and observations about routes; not an exposition child who knows every secret
profiles.private_life: Keeps delivery fees separately from other people's deposits
profiles.end_state: Receives stable care with his participation in the arrangement; household belonging is not an ownership transfer

profiles.name: Jin Chan
profiles.want: Keep credit flowing under the Exchange he controls
profiles.fear: A run that proves his methods cannot protect his own family
profiles.mistaken_belief: Only private ownership with decisive power can prevent financial collapse
profiles.competence: Prices risk, manages inventory and knows whose claims can delay others
profiles.harm_or_cost: Predatory exclusions and hidden debits benefit his office; losing an Audit does not pay everyone's debts
profiles.independent_relationship: Jinling hears his fear but rejects inheriting sole authority; depositors have claims independent of their family
profiles.voice: Jovial calculation becomes defensive accounting; avoids a generic miser sneer
profiles.private_life: Reads warehouse reports and notices a delayed shipment before entertaining petitioners
profiles.end_state: Lives under review after losing monopoly control; relinquishment does not erase legal obligations

profiles.name: Ox-Head
profiles.want: Keep dangerous crossings bounded and coordinated
profiles.fear: A hurried exception becoming harm to another traveller
profiles.mistaken_belief: Only simultaneous formal compliance can prove cooperation
profiles.competence: Physical gate timing and stated trial objectives
profiles.harm_or_cost: Must provide refusal and cancellation rather than force worship through injury
profiles.independent_relationship: Horse-Face can challenge an unsafe interpretation of their shared rule
profiles.voice: Brief paired conditions, no taunting at the dead
profiles.private_life: Maintains a crossing mechanism that must function for ordinary travellers
profiles.end_state: Bows when the objective is met and remains a keeper, not a corpse or a recruited weapon

profiles.name: Horse-Face
profiles.want: Bring travellers through a valid trial without separating vulnerable parties
profiles.fear: Rules being applied one person at a time to defeat their purpose
profiles.mistaken_belief: An explicit rule always anticipates every circumstance
profiles.competence: Watches timing and communicates the paired condition
profiles.harm_or_cost: Has to clarify an ambiguous instruction before enforcing it
profiles.independent_relationship: Ox-Head shares responsibility; neither silently corrects the other's error after the fact
profiles.voice: Precise restatement and confirmation rather than identical twin dialogue
profiles.private_life: Checks the return route as carefully as the entry
profiles.end_state: Recognizes the completed cooperation and preserves the trial record

profiles.name: Judge Cui
profiles.want: Permit a correction without destroying its evidence
profiles.fear: That a beautiful new account will erase someone whose copy is inconvenient
profiles.mistaken_belief: A valid amendment can be certified without considering who retains access
profiles.competence: Brush rules, witnesses and counter-record preservation
profiles.harm_or_cost: Must refuse an unsafe shortcut even when Nil's cause is sympathetic
profiles.independent_relationship: Bai Si brings disagreement; Enma's independent jurisdiction limits any universal answer
profiles.voice: Careful verbs distinguishing erase, amend and preserve
profiles.private_life: Cleans and rests the brush between claims instead of performing ceaseless magic
profiles.end_state: Authorizes bounded Rewrite and preserves the counter-record; revered role is not an enemy target

profiles.name: Wen
profiles.want: During life, make a ferry rope someone else could trust
profiles.fear: A failed splice injuring a passenger
profiles.mistaken_belief: His life is not reduced to a moral lesson inferred from his death
profiles.competence: Rope craft survives in a work knot and dated testimony
profiles.harm_or_cost: He is dead; a correct count cannot return his future to his family
profiles.independent_relationship: Descendants and River-born workers preserve craft without pretending to be current eyewitnesses of an ancient death
profiles.voice: Quoted work instructions and preserved testimony only; no omniscient ghost explaining Nil
profiles.private_life: Specific repairs and a maker's knot identify a life beyond the missing fraction
profiles.end_state: A disputed life is recorded accurately and remembered; no resurrection or lantern ownership

profiles.name: Vidya Rao
profiles.want: Finish a defensible catalogue and keep the observatory operating
profiles.fear: Political suppression and an unsupported result destroying trust
profiles.mistaken_belief: Protecting a promising student requires smoothing away their public mistakes
profiles.competence: Independent measurement, calibration and signed dispatches
profiles.harm_or_cost: Must retain Shunya's failed model and pay instrument crews even when publication is dangerous
profiles.independent_relationship: Shunya can outgrow his model; Meera's private record is not his departmental property
profiles.voice: Patient examples and exact observations; will say he does not know
profiles.private_life: Schedules instruments around maintenance, weather and the crew's wages
profiles.end_state: Publishes bounded measurements and a failed-test appendix without claiming Nil's personal data

profiles.name: Meera
profiles.want: Recover her brother's record and keep control of what is shared
profiles.fear: That scholars will turn a loss into evidence she cannot retrieve
profiles.mistaken_belief: A complete record may answer every unresolved feeling
profiles.competence: Diving lines, depth limits, return planning and retrieval documentation
profiles.harm_or_cost: Risk is physical and paid; agreeing to retrieval is not blanket publication consent
profiles.independent_relationship: Shunya needs her permission; Vidya's institutional archive must return the private original
profiles.voice: Specific depth and safety instructions; grief changes the subject rather than becoming an explanatory speech
profiles.private_life: Checks lamp seals and does not enter water because a protagonist is impatient
profiles.end_state: Receives the record, permits a limited comparison and keeps grief without an invented cure

profiles.name: Chitragupta
profiles.want: Keep deeds legible without converting a person into a verdict
profiles.fear: A new measurement reproducing an older erasure
profiles.mistaken_belief: Recording more detail necessarily makes a record exhaustive
profiles.competence: Compares regional meanings and defines a nonlethal record trial
profiles.harm_or_cost: Must distinguish his account's limits from a claim to own the subject
profiles.independent_relationship: Shunya's hypothesis is examined rather than blessed; Meera's record has an owner
profiles.voice: Formal distinctions grounded in a particular entry, not a lecture on an entire real religion
profiles.private_life: Preserves a counter-copy and the unanswered question beside it
profiles.end_state: Supplies independent evidence without becoming Hap in disguise or a defeated enemy

profiles.name: Kallisto
profiles.want: Safe access and authority for the residents maintaining the city
profiles.fear: A celebrated outsider leaving residents with broken routes and reprisals
profiles.mistaken_belief: Immediate unity is always necessary to win a hearing
profiles.competence: Organizes labour, local knowledge, witnesses and practical evacuation
profiles.harm_or_cost: Can pressure dissenting residents to accept one plan; must record their disagreement
profiles.independent_relationship: Prima owes testimony before trust; Maeve works under local repair priorities
profiles.voice: Names a task, responsible person and deadline; anger is specific rather than constant rhetoric
profiles.private_life: Checks a support before accepting a speech about the upper city
profiles.end_state: Residents govern reopened routes and can challenge the proposed transition rather than thank the party and disappear

profiles.name: Niko
profiles.want: Do something useful in a city that overlooks him
profiles.fear: Being treated as a joke whenever a task fails
profiles.mistaken_belief: Being a hero means taking a risk alone
profiles.competence: Knows goats and narrow routes adults do not use
profiles.harm_or_cost: His mistakes must not turn actual falls or children in danger into recurring slapstick
profiles.independent_relationship: Kallisto can assign safe useful work; Prima must respect a child's information without handing him a soldier's duty
profiles.voice: Eager specific claims, often corrected by an escaped goat rather than by contempt
profiles.private_life: Counts animals and learns where a weak terrace edge really leads
profiles.end_state: Helps identify a safe route under adult responsibility and remains a child

profiles.name: Clotho
profiles.want: Establish a sequence everyone understands before acting
profiles.fear: An interrupted order that traps the next participant
profiles.mistaken_belief: An elegant sequence remains safe without checking comprehension
profiles.competence: Spinning and observable ordered trials
profiles.harm_or_cost: Must restart an unclear instruction rather than blame a traveller for misreading
profiles.independent_relationship: Lachesis checks the relationships the sequence assumes; Atropos defines its ending boundary
profiles.voice: Measured instructions with one explicit example
profiles.private_life: Adjusts tension before asking someone to put a hand near the wheel
profiles.end_state: Certifies a bounded trial, not authority over the party's entire future

profiles.name: Lachesis
profiles.want: Measure a shared obligation without ranking lives
profiles.fear: Measurement being used to claim a person's ownership
profiles.mistaken_belief: Participants who agree to a trial agree to every later use of its record
profiles.competence: Measured thread, witnessed limits and record custody
profiles.harm_or_cost: Must separate trial consent from the finale's later request
profiles.independent_relationship: Prima and Nil reason through a disagreement; Clotho cannot substitute compliance for permission
profiles.voice: Questions about scope, followed by a precise statement of what the strand records
profiles.private_life: Repairs a measuring mark rather than secretly moving it
profiles.end_state: Releases the witnessed thread with limits; Prima retains authority over final use

profiles.name: Atropos
profiles.want: Make a real ending possible without disguised coercion
profiles.fear: A costly choice being passed off as voluntary because alternatives were hidden
profiles.mistaken_belief: A sacrifice appears more honest when it hurts more
profiles.competence: States permitted substitutions and closure conditions
profiles.harm_or_cost: Must provide the expendable ribbon explicitly and never consume a protected proof or person
profiles.independent_relationship: Clotho's sequence and Lachesis's record need a declared end, not an arbitrary severing
profiles.voice: Plain questions and unromantic descriptions of consequences
profiles.private_life: Keeps discarded test ribbon separate from live records
profiles.end_state: Accepts a bounded material cost, no demanded companion death or erased evidence

profiles.name: Archon
profiles.want: Preserve the ranked city and the authority that maintains it
profiles.fear: Admission that excluded residents built the stability he claims
profiles.mistaken_belief: Numerical qualification can establish political worth
profiles.competence: Knows geometric machinery and the institution's access rules
profiles.harm_or_cost: His exclusions and school order endanger children; saving him does not restore his office
profiles.independent_relationship: Prima was a sincere student, not an idiot he deceived in every lesson; Kallisto's witnesses challenge his jurisdiction
profiles.voice: Didactic complete assertions; cites a real working structure before applying its false moral conclusion
profiles.private_life: Inspects a functioning shelter while refusing to recognize who was excluded from it
profiles.end_state: Survives under witness custody and public review after losing monopoly power

profiles.name: Stranger
profiles.want: Make a declared bargain possible to refuse
profiles.fear: A signature obtained through hidden terms being called an agreement
profiles.mistaken_belief: A formally fair offer always accounts for unequal bargaining power
profiles.competence: Discloses stakes and teaches a bounded Deal without cheating
profiles.harm_or_cost: Must allow the exhausted party to decline rather than make entry conditional on submission
profiles.independent_relationship: Vesper knows fair play requires exposure of her own methods; the House offers the contrasting imposed contract
profiles.voice: Few words, asks what the traveller thinks they are offering
profiles.private_life: Sets down the book so both parties can see the same page
profiles.end_state: Remains a keeper of bounded terms rather than a villain revealed by a trick

profiles.name: Penny
profiles.want: Leave the railway without losing the record of the nights
profiles.fear: That spending a token will erase what she has kept
profiles.mistaken_belief: A count by itself can settle the obligation holding her
profiles.competence: Recognizes authorized counters and the sequence of repeated departures
profiles.harm_or_cost: Tokens are nonspendable records, not a source of newly created money
profiles.independent_relationship: Vance checks the count against case markers; Fibi can contradict Penny's remembered sequence
profiles.voice: Patient recurring phrases interrupted by exact corrections
profiles.private_life: Sorts tokens by worn edges, not increasing magical purchasing power
profiles.end_state: The clause's cancellation permits departure; no literal extra currency must be minted to free her

profiles.name: Vance
profiles.want: Make a charge stick against property power without inventing evidence
profiles.fear: Losing public authority and leaving staff less protected
profiles.mistaken_belief: One impeccable case file can act without witnesses who are allowed to disagree
profiles.competence: Separates case records, property claims and signed testimony
profiles.harm_or_cost: Her office relies on House credit and retained markers; she must disclose those dependencies
profiles.independent_relationship: Penny corroborates but does not replace Fibi; staff can dispute her proposed settlement
profiles.voice: Specific questions, dates and contradictions; no all-knowing frontier drawl
profiles.private_life: Notches authorized case markers and keeps ordinary wage complaints in the same office
profiles.end_state: Preserves cancellation and restitution evidence and accepts public oversight rather than simply arresting away an economy

profiles.name: House
profiles.want: Keep Fibi safe while retaining the property network that defines his competence
profiles.fear: Losing her and discovering that protection caused the harm
profiles.mistaken_belief: Buying protection entitles him to control its beneficiary
profiles.competence: Contracts, funding, bounded rewinds and real staff logistics
profiles.harm_or_cost: Commissioned the protection when Fibi was15; continuing control at18 drains her and employees depend on his assets
profiles.independent_relationship: Fibi's refusal limits family authority; Vance and staff hold independent claims he cannot settle with affection
profiles.voice: Affable offers with conditions; uses family terms to evade a precise consent question
profiles.private_life: Knows the cost of a replacement felt table and ignores an excluded person's larger cost
profiles.end_state: Lives after relinquishing the claim; signs the cancellation and faces wage/property proceedings

profiles.name: Mara
profiles.want: Have her family's chosen restitution recognized without performing forgiveness
profiles.fear: That Vesper will turn her survival into a redemption story
profiles.mistaken_belief: She is not required to have a corrective flaw to justify refusing contact
profiles.competence: Works with a mutual-aid office and can direct how her statement and family fund are handled
profiles.harm_or_cost: Injury, disrupted schooling and displacement remain consequences; no image of recovery cancels them
profiles.independent_relationship: Her family and colleagues exist independently of Vesper; Fibi need not mediate a reunion
profiles.voice: Direct boundaries and concrete requests; no required cathartic speech to the protagonist
profiles.private_life: Has work shifts and education outside the scene about what happened to her
profiles.end_state: Chooses the terms of contact, receives directed restitution and is not obliged to forgive

groups.House staff: Casino employees with independent wage/property claims
groups.Synod guards: Institutional staff; obedience is not a universal personal motive
groups.children: Age-appropriate residents; no mandatory fighting role
groups.companions: Current travel roster, not a three-member combat limit
groups.courier: Paid carrier on the established dispatch route
groups.depositors: Reserve claimants distinct from the Exchange owner
groups.dock witnesses: Cooperative residents retaining their own testimony
groups.guards: Assigned security personnel with actual orders and physical limits
groups.regional councils: Distinct provisional local bodies, not one global mind
groups.regional delegates: Specific limited representatives whose mandates are recorded
groups.surveyors: Basilica operators with permits and machinery, not celestial figures
groups.witness: Custodian of a particular statement, not omniscient narration
groups.workers: Skilled residents with varied wages, obligations and political positions
